key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:B65E
name: pick_direction_from_axis_offset
description: Measures how far one object sits from a fixed centre point along one axis, ignoring sign, and compares that distance with the other object's distance to return one of two direction codes. The sign of the first offset is passed back in the high word.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:B682
name: choose_direction_by_axis_threshold
description: Compares one object's offset from a fixed centre on one axis with a threshold passed on the stack and returns one of two direction codes depending on which side of the threshold it falls.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:B694
name: return_constant_direction_42
description: Returns the fixed direction code 42 without any computation, so every caller that reaches it always gets the same direction.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:B69A
name: choose_direction_for_object_pair
description: Compares the horizontal separation of two objects against 384. When they are close it picks direction 21 or 25 from their vertical offsets; when they are far it picks 37 or 41 instead.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:B6B4
name: choose_direction_for_near_or_far_pair
description: Uses the same near-or-far test as its neighbour, with the operands swapped, to pick between direction codes 21 and 25 for close pairs and 37 and 41 for distant pairs.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:B6DC
name: select_direction_by_offset_order
description: Folds one object's offset from the centre to a magnitude and compares it with the other object's offset, returning direction 21 when the first is smaller and 25 otherwise.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:B700
name: select_direction_against_stack_limit
description: Folds an offset from the centre to a magnitude and compares it with a limit passed on the stack, returning direction 21 below the limit and 25 at or above it.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:B712
name: return_constant_direction_25
description: Returns the fixed direction code 25 with no further work, serving as a constant answer for its callers.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:B716
name: compare_folded_offsets_for_direction
description: Folds two objects' offsets from the centre to magnitudes and returns direction 37 when the second is smaller than the first, otherwise 41.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:B730
name: pick_direction_by_offset_order
description: Folds one object's offset from the centre to a magnitude and returns direction 37 if it is smaller than the other object's offset, otherwise 41.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:B754
name: select_alt_direction_against_stack_limit
description: Compares an offset from the centre with a stack limit and returns direction 37 when the offset is below the limit and 41 otherwise.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:B766
name: return_constant_direction_41
description: Returns the fixed direction code 41 immediately; it is a constant answer used by four different callers.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:B772
name: find_record_by_key_in_table
description: Walks a table of record pointers from its last slot, stepping back by the requested key each time, until it finds a record whose key field equals the parameter, and returns that record.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:B78A
name: find_record_matching_key_field
description: Scans the record table from a fixed start slot, stepping back by a key value taken from the caller's record, and returns the first record whose key field matches.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:B7BC
name: stub_return_without_action
description: Returns at once with no side effects; it is an empty entry point that leaves the caller unaffected.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:B7C6
name: find_matching_entry_by_mask
description: Scans a table of 62-byte entries, starting at an index derived from a count field, and tests each entry's flag word against the request mask. It returns the first matching entry or a null pointer when none matches within the count.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:B856
name: get_string_by_index
description: Returns the string pointer stored at the requested index of the global string table. Indexes above 999 first trigger an error report for an invalid string access in STRINGS.C.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:B8B4
name: load_and_split_strings_file
description: Loads the STRINGS.DAT text file, reporting open, seek, read and allocation failures with their own messages in STRINGS.C. It then builds a table of line pointers, converting carriage returns and stopping at control characters.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:BA98
name: negate_and_swap_paired_state_words
description: Negates two signed fields, calls two helper routines with values derived from them, then swaps four pairs of stored words in the global state table.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:BB40
name: rewrite_six_table_words
description: Runs a six-iteration loop over consecutive words of a global table and writes each word back. The decompiled assignments read and write the same location, so the exact transformation cannot be recovered from this listing.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:BC26
name: copy_table_entry_by_case
description: Advances a table index and, for a mode value from 2 to 6, copies the indexed word into two neighbouring slots around a selected position. The visible cases perform the same two copies.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:BC3C
name: copy_indexed_word_to_neighbour_slots
description: Copies the word addressed by a table index into two slots beside a selected position. Its referenced text names a fixture lookup, which is the only hint about its use.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:BEBA
name: award_league_points_for_result
description: Searches two table positions for given values, then adds three points to the winner or one point to each side of a draw. The increments shown are the pattern of three for a win and one for a draw.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:C0EA
name: emit_fixed_spaced_rows
description: Builds a 21-byte local record and emits a sequence of rows at offsets 8, 40 and 72, with a pair of identifiers that step by three between rows.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:C350
name: emit_optional_row_sequence
description: Emits a fixed series of rows at positions sixteen units apart, showing each row only when its matching flag word is non-negative. Each row is produced by the same sequence of helper calls.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:C508
name: emit_rows_for_nonnegative_entries
description: Walks a range of table entries and emits one row for each entry whose value is non-negative, advancing the row position by eight units each time. A fixed header row is emitted first.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:C5E8
name: select_value_when_field_matches
description: Compares a word parameter with a stored value and returns 22 when they are equal and 11 otherwise.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:C60E
name: lookup_table_word_after_init
description: Returns the table word stored one position past the given index. It first runs the table initialiser when that index is one.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:C65C
name: initialise_match_state_and_tables
description: A very large setup routine that clears several state counters, sets table size and index constants, and calls about thirty-nine helper routines. Its only text reference is a short tag that does not reveal more about its role.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:FF3A
name: stub_return_unreached_gap
description: Returns immediately with no side effects. It is a stray return that the disassembler found in a gap between routines.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:FF3E
name: sweep_adjacent_entries_with_flags
description: Sets a flag bit in three byte cells, then repeatedly walks a grid of table entries, calling a helper where a flag or counter condition holds. It compares adjacent table entries for inequality to decide whether another pass is needed.
